methodology.executed_action_baseline: first trading session open strictly after source date when no reliable intraday timestamp exists
methodology.planned_entry_baseline: explicit stock-entry plans begin only on the first later session whose low touches the stated level; each tranche is validated separately
methodology.untriggered_plan: kept as not_triggered and excluded from return/alignment aggregates
methodology.benchmark: QQQ when the same baseline session exists
methodology.directional_alignment: descriptive only; explicit staged stock-entry plans are treated bullish after trigger; sell/trim/clear bearish
methodology.sell_put_limit: without option premium/expiry/IV, Sell Put P&L and alignment are not scored; strike-touch remains descriptive
methodology.attribution_limit: third-party examples are excluded; unconfirmed source context is visible but excluded from aggregate method memory

guardrails: External-source outcomes are descriptive evidence, not rankings or automatic trade rules.
Quoted third-party examples are excluded from author-level outcome aggregates.
Unconfirmed attribution is excluded from aggregate method memory.
Planned entries are scored only after the exact stated price level is actually touched.
Sell Put is not assigned a synthetic P&L when premium/expiry/IV are missing.
No learning result changes production thresholds without separate validation.

history_sources.principle: STOOQ core wins at whole-symbol level; baseline and every horizon for an event use the same target-symbol source. yfinance remains validation-only fallback.
